lines.text: Many learners say: My house is near from here.
Better: My house is near here.
The! The bank is near the station.

data.wrong: My house is near from here.

native.tip: ‘여기서 가까워요’의 ‘서’ 때문에 from을 넣기 쉬워요. far from은 맞지만 near 뒤엔 바로 장소! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “near here.”
native.caption: “My house is near from here”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 near는 그 자체로 ‘~에서 가까운’이라서 from이 필요 없어요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “My house is near here.” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “the”! near 뒤엔 from 없이! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Near needs no from. Say “My house is near here.”
en.caption: Do you say “My house is near from here” in English? 😅 Near already means close to, so you do not add “from”! “My house is near here” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
